items.title: Violent protesters or police brutality? Key moments from Sydney protest
items.description: Competing narratives have emerged from NSW Police and protesters who were at Monday night's demonstration near Sydney's Town Hall. ABC NEWS Verify has gathered footage and spoken to witnesses in an early attempt to examine what happened in detail.

items.title: ASIO ordered independent review into Bondi terror case, stands by 2019 assessment
items.description: The nation's top spy has welcomed a royal commission into the Bondi terror attack, vowing to "own any mistakes" uncovered by the probe as his agency comes under pressure over whether the tragedy could have been prevented.

items.title: Liberals plot leadership challenge
items.description: Liberals are bracing for a wave of frontbench resignations as soon as Wednesday to pave the way for Angus Taylor to mount a leadership challenge against Sussan Ley.

items.title: More than 80 per cent of GP visits bulk-billed, according to new data
items.description: Bulk-billing rates have rebounded in the first clear measure of the impact of the government's multi-billion-dollar pledge.

items.title: Telstra joint venture to cut up to 209 jobs as AI projects evolve
items.description: The Telstra joint venture said this move will "bring an enhanced experience" to its customers, but did not make clear how many jobs in the joint venture (JV) are set to be moved to India.

items.title: Live: Aussie Anthony makes brilliant start to Olympic title defence
items.description: Reigning Olympic gold medallist Jakara Anthony produces an outstanding performance to reach the women's moguls final at the Milano Cortina Games. Follow live.

items.title: Claims of harmful drinking water, low pay: What's happening with Carnival?
items.description: A major cruise ship has been investigated by the maritime safety regulator for claims around poor working conditions. A spokesperson for The Carnival Cruise Line says it has "nothing to hide" and welcomes AMSA's oversight. Here's what we know so far.

items.title: Car key, more bones found in search for Celine Cremer
items.description: Tasmania Police have located further items while searching for missing Belgian tourist Celine Cremer, including more bones and a car key which has been "formally verified" as having belonged to her.

items.title: Top barrister and charity boss dead after child abuse arrest
items.description: The 60-year-old was found dead at his Leichhardt unit in Sydney's inner west on Monday evening, NSW Police said in a statement.

items.title: Four stand trial after man's remains found in wheelie bin
items.description: Four people, including the victim's former partner, are standing trial in relation to the alleged murder of 55-year-old man Geoffrey McLean, whose remains were found in a wheelie bin in Adelaide's north in 2022. Warning: This story contains details that some readers may find distressing.

items.title: Rental affordability hits new low as rents rise faster than wages
items.description: Tenants now pay an average of 33.4 per cent of their pre-tax income on rent, which is the highest level on record, according to a property research firm.

items.title: Ghislaine Maxwell helped Jeffrey Epstein hide behind a veil of wealth
items.description: Powerful socialite Ghislaine Maxwell was able to exploit her connections to recruit, groom, and abuse dozens of young girls. Now, she faces a fresh interrogation over her role in Jeffrey Epstein's abuse.

items.title: Government pressures Lao authorities over methanol poisoning deaths
items.description: The Australian government calls in the Lao ambassador in Canberra, amid criticism of the country's response to a fatal methanol poisoning.

items.title: Rain streams down Uluru as large parts of NT soaked by wet weather
items.description: Heavy rain in Central Australia has sent waterfalls down the face of Uluru and filled the usually parched Todd River, while cutting off a number of remote communities.

items.title: Pilot failed two exams but held licence ahead of fatal crash
items.description: When a young pilot crashed his aircraft he and his two passengers died, but there are questions as to why he was even flying after failing two exams.

items.title: I love caring for my brother, but I didn't have enough support at school
items.description: I was my brother's protector at school, but the education system could have done more to support us both.

items.title: Bondi terrorist father was 'more extremist' than son, former spy says
items.description: Bondi Beach terrorist Sajid Akram voiced support for the Islamic State group (IS) in 2019 and expressed admiration for a leading Al Qaeda propagandist, according to accounts from two men who moved in the same extremist circles.

items.title: 'He was pleased': Christchurch terrorist's former lawyer addresses court
items.description: A former lawyer for the Australian who murdered 51 people at two New Zealand mosques in 2019 tells a court the shooter "never wanted to defend the terrorism charge".

items.title: Man staged partner's murder scene before calling Triple Zero
items.description: New details have emerged about the murder of Canberra woman Tiffany Spence, as court documents show her partner staged the scene before calling Triple Zero.

items.title: Fourteen face court over alleged attack on Indigenous protest camp
items.description: Neo-Nazi leader Thomas Sewell was among more than a dozen people to face a Melbourne court on Tuesday over the alleged attack at Camp Sovereignty near the city's CBD last August.

items.title: Woman tells court of pregnancy scare after alleged abuse as student
items.description: When recounting the first time her former teacher allegedly raped her, the woman told the court he was "like a big monster" on top of her and she "could hardly breathe". The woman is suing both her former teacher and the State of Tasmania.

items.title: Global Athlete accuses IOC of 'kowtowing' to Russia and calls for heavier sanctions
items.description: Advocacy group Global Athlete has accused the IOC of enabling Russia by allowing 13 Russian and seven Belarusian athletes to compete at the Winter Olympics.

items.title: Controversial construction policy cost Queenslanders billions, inquiry told
items.description: Industry warnings about a controversial construction industry code were ignored by former Labor leaders, an inquiry into the CFMEU has heard.

items.title: Missing woman 'frightened' before 1986 disappearance, murder trial told
items.description: A close friend of a woman allegedly murdered by her husband in Perth 40 years ago tells a Perth court she seemed frightened in the hours before her disappearance.

items.title: Transport industry calls out so-called 'sham contracting'
items.description: Advocates within the trucking industry are saying misuse of roadside parking bays is putting fatigued drivers at risk.
